items.key_finding: S&P 500 outperformed MTUM by 9.71 percentage points over five trading days, the largest five-day relative advantage in Barron's analysis.
items.summary: The November 4 close confirmed a sharp split: the broad market rallied while previously favored growth sectors fell. The S&P 500 beat the momentum ETF by 9.71 points over five trading days, the widest gap in Barron's analysis.
items.title: EXAMPLE — Momentum stocks experience historic relative underperformance

items.key_finding: Energy markets are pricing anticipated diplomatic progress before the corresponding physical supply improvement has been demonstrated.
items.summary: Brent and WTI settled down more than 8% on November 4, a move the market reads as falling geopolitical risk premiums rather than confirmed physical supply recovery. Hormuz shipping constraints and low distillate inventories persist.
items.title: EXAMPLE — Oil's extraordinary decline is confirmed at settlement
